- Preferred enrollment: supplier portal enrollment or Hub-based vendor portal works well for Orchid — we can accept enrollment via a portal or direct paperwork.

- Pilot threshold: for small pilots under $25k we typically accept CC or a p-card. Anything expected >$25k we recommend a PO so it's on record and can be reserved in our finance system.

On Thu, Mar 11, 2027 at 5:48 PM Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> Marissa / Ben — forwarding Aisha's intake and our packet. Can you confirm the PO timeline and whether Finance needs any special vendor codes for Orchid? Also, if we recommend marketplace enrollment (AWS Marketplace) as a path for them, what are the pros/cons and how long does activation take?

Thanks — happy to take this. Quick answers for you to share with Orchid: 

- W-9 vs W-8: If Orchid is US-registered (tax address in the US) they should complete and return the W-9; if non-US, we need the appropriate W-8 form. We can accept either via portal upload or DocuSign.
- Vendor activation SLA: Full vendor packet via email + W-9 typically results in activation in 5-7 business days. If they enroll through a supplier portal with automated verification, it can be shortened to ~3 business days depending on portal latency.
- Pilot payment path: For pilots under $25k recommend p-card for speed (no PO required). If they want invoice terms or the pilot will exceed $25k, submit a PO — finance requires PO number, billing contact, and the signed vendor packet.
- Marketplace: AWS Marketplace is great for customers who want consolidated billing and a straightforward procurement route; onboarding to marketplace can take 2-3 weeks (partner setup + procurement mapping). If Orchid needs a short pilot window, recommend start via p-card or direct invoice and then transition to marketplace for production.

Suggested reply to Aisha (you can copy/paste):

Hi Aisha — quick answers from Finance: we can accept vendor portal enrollment or direct packet; please return the attached vendor packet and W-9. For pilots under $25k a p-card is the fastest path; PO required for >$25k or if Orchids prefers net terms. Vendor activation after complete packet is ~5-7 business days (portal can be faster). If you want marketplace billing for later production that is an option but usually takes 2-3 weeks to activate.
